last_completed_unit.target: Cargo Reference / Source Replacement / local-registry configuration
last_completed_unit.finding: Cargo officially documents source replacement in .cargo/config.toml, including local-registry = "path/to/registry" and replace-with for selecting a replacement source. The same page defines local registry sources as local-filesystem registry subsets downloaded ahead of time.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Official Cargo configuration can select an already-existing local-registry source through source replacement rather than naming a remote registry endpoint for that replacement source.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Chat-native local-registry population, Cargo process execution from scheduled Chat, universal offline behavior for all Cargo commands, or end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main freshness metadata, and exactly one official Cargo Reference lookup at https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/source-replacement.html.
scope_guard: Configuration-path evidence only. It does not prove recurring scheduled Chat can create the local registry, run Cargo, or complete a build without a richer execution surface.
